Definition: Status of the report (e.g. preliminary, final, corrected).
Clinical classification of the microbiological report (LOINC). Multiple entries if the report covers several study types, e.g. bacteriological and mycological.
Patient to whom the report relates.
Time to which the content of the report relates (usually the time of specimen collection).

Short: Source of the clinical reference time
Definition: Indicates what the clinical reference time refers to, e.g. time of specimen collection or receipt in the laboratory.
Time at which the report was released or made available.
Person who clinically assesses and is responsible for the report.
Specimens on which the report is based.
The microbiological investigations contained in the report.
